model.description: Shows the last 100 package operations (install/remove/upgrade) for all systems.

targets.rawSql: SELECT action_id, action_name, scheduler_username, event, in_progress_systems, completed_systems, failed_systems FROM actionsreport WHERE (event LIKE '%Package Install%' OR event LIKE '%Package Upgrade%' OR event LIKE '%Package Removal%' OR event LIKE '%Patch Update%') ORDER BY action_id DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT system_id, package_name, package_version, package_release FROM systempackagesinstalledreport WHERE package_name = '$search_package' GROUP BY system_id, package_name, package_version, package_release ORDER BY package_version ASC
SELECT action_id, action_name, scheduler_username, event, in_progress_systems, completed_systems, failed_systems FROM actionsreport ORDER BY action_id DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Shows the current results for execution of a scheduled action in SUSE Multi-Linux Manager.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  earliest_action,
  action_name,
  scheduler_username,
    (
    COALESCE(LENGTH(in_progress_systems) - LENGTH(REPLACE(in_progress_systems, ';', '')) + 1, 0)
  ) AS progress_count,
  (
    COALESCE(LENGTH(completed_systems) - LENGTH(REPLACE(completed_systems, ';', '')) + 1, 0)
  ) AS completed_count,
  (
    COALESCE(LENGTH(failed_systems) - LENGTH(REPLACE(failed_systems, ';', '')) + 1, 0)
  ) AS failed_count,
  in_progress_systems,
  completed_systems,
  failed_systems
FROM
  actionsreport
WHERE
  action_id = $action_id
LIMIT
  1

panels.title: Scheduled Action Results: $action_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT kernel_version, COUNT(kernel_version) FROM inventoryreport GROUP BY kernel_version LIMIT 50
SELECT minion_os_family, COUNT(minion_os_family) FROM system GROUP BY minion_os_family LIMIT 50
SELECT system_name, group_name FROM systemgroupssystemsreport WHERE group_name = '$group_search' LIMIT 50
SELECT system_id, system_name, key, value, synced_date FROM custominforeport GROUP BY system_name, system_id, key, value, synced_date LIMIT 50

SELECT mgm_id, system_id, profile_name, hostname, kernel_version, architecture, hardware, packages_out_of_date, errata_out_of_date, ip_address, primary_interface, hardware_address FROM inventoryreport LIMIT 50
SELECT hostname, errata_id, advisory_type, advisory_name FROM systemerrata WHERE advisory_type LIKE '%Security%' GROUP BY hostname, advisory_type, errata_id, advisory_name ORDER BY hostname
SELECT mgm_id, system_id, packages_out_of_date, errata_out_of_date, synced_date FROM systemoutdated LIMIT 50
